changelog:
industry-chain-intelligence v1.0.0

- Initial release: Generate 10-page, white paper-style HTML strategic reports for CEOs/CTOs, covering full industry chain analysis, upstream risk, downstream markets, technical competition, innovation radar, trends, and action roadmaps.
- Strictly follows coolingstyle_v2_whitepaper.html visual guidelines (ivory background, navy/vermillion/gold accents, specified fonts, 960px layout).
- Real-time data integration from PatSnap MCP for up-to-date industry, technology, patent, and company metrics (2012–present).
- All conclusions are evidence-based with quantitative metrics, clear references, risk grading, and peer benchmarking.
- Includes enhanced modules for supply chain bottleneck analysis, patent expiry windows, innovation gap-based talent recommendations, and government support track.
- Designed for high-authority, executive-level decision support.
summary: 企业决策者产业链战略报告系统。面向企业CEO/CTO/战略总监，输入公司名称或产业链， 一键生成10页白皮书风格HTML报告，涵盖产业链定位、上游卡脖子风险、下游市场格局、 技术竞争态势、科创力雷达、趋势机会及行动路线图。 视觉风格严格遵循 coolingstyle_v2_whitepaper.html 白皮书 DNA：象牙白底、深海军蓝标题、 朱红强调、古金装饰、Noto Serif/Sans/Roboto Mono 字体三件套、960px宽/52px页边距。 数据通过智慧芽MCP实时获取，图表默认统计范围2012-当前年月。
